name: Witch Doctor: Bwonsamdi's Edge raises Spirit Eclipse's explosion damage (#1363)
contract: Regression for #1363: Bwonsamdi's Edge (712435) carries ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108), EffectMiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), classmask word1 bit 3 (8), matching exactly the SpellFamilyFlags[1]=8 of Spirit Eclipse Explosion (802712, SpellFamilyName 19). EffectBasePoints[0]=39 -> real 40%, the tooltip's 'Your Spirit Eclipse now deals 40% increased damage when it explodes on impact'. The splash is a scripted helper: the Spirit Eclipse aura snapshots its damage through SpellDamageBonusDone of the parent aura (801607, flags word0 0x20000000 only, so the word1 bit never matches) and casts 802712 with that amount, and 802712 is corrected to SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS so the parent's modifiers are not applied twice. That attribute made SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod reject every modifier on 802712, so Bwonsamdi's Edge never reached the splash (this metric read 1000 for every op). The splash snapshot now applies 802712's SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, and IsAffectedBySpellMod admits only Bwonsamdi's Edge's percent damage modifier past the attribute; 712435 is the only family-19 damage modifier whose mask reaches 802712 without also reaching 801607, so no parent modifier is counted twice. This metric is the value the snapshot multiplies by.

steps.label: No damage bonus on Spirit Eclipse Explosion before Bwonsamdi's Edge
Bwonsamdi's Edge aura applies after learn
Bwonsamdi's Edge adds 40% damage to Spirit Eclipse Explosion
Damage bonus reverts once Bwonsamdi's Edge is unlearned
